raw.rationale: CEP-37440 is a potent ALK inhibitor, so selective killing is expected mainly in ALK-driven lineages, especially lung (ALK fusion NSCLC) and possibly central nervous system (ALK-altered tumors), while most other lineages lack ALK dependence and should show little selectivity. Published PRISM-type screens generally show ALK inhibitors as selective for ALK-fusion-positive lung cancer lines, with low base-rate probabilities elsewhere.
